case_analysis.thread_summary: The thread covers completion of a Bluetooth SIG product listing, validation of submission content before publication, and preparation of a post-listing compliance folder. During review, the consultant identifies metadata inconsistencies, including an outdated Bluetooth version reference and confirmation of the correct model designation. After publication, attention shifts to collecting supporting compliance documentation such as manuals, block diagrams, mechanical drawings, and antenna information. The discussion also addresses how to proceed when some compliance-folder documents are not immediately available.
case_analysis.key_technical_discussion: The consultant reviews qualification submission data before final submission and verifies that product metadata accurately reflects the qualified Bluetooth version. An incorrect reference to Bluetooth v4.1 is corrected to v5.2 before publication. For compliance-folder preparation, the consultant specifies required supporting documentation, including Bluetooth-related user documentation, block diagrams, external drawings, and antenna datasheets containing radiation gain characteristics. The thread further explains that antenna datasheets typically come from existing regulatory-certification documentation rather than a Bluetooth-specific template.
case_analysis.key_decision_logic: Qualification records and publicly visible listing information must accurately reflect the qualified product configuration before submission. After listing, the compliance package should contain sufficient technical evidence to support the qualified design. If required compliance documents are temporarily unavailable, the folder structure can be delivered with placeholders, allowing the final documents to be inserted later while preserving the compliance-folder organization.
case_analysis.risk_if_done_wrong: Incorrect product metadata, such as an inaccurate Bluetooth version description, can result in misleading qualification records and require correction before publication. Missing compliance-folder documents may delay completion of the compliance package. Failure to obtain appropriate antenna documentation and supporting technical records can leave the compliance archive incomplete and create additional follow-up work later.
case_analysis.consulting_takeaway: Before final Bluetooth SIG submission, perform a detailed review of all customer-visible metadata and qualification information. After listing, proactively collect compliance-folder evidence—including antenna documentation and product technical records—and use a controlled placeholder strategy when some documents are not yet available so that the compliance package can still be delivered in a maintainable form.
